items.title: Henry Russ Interview, 1972-01-18
items.q: He's playing all of Richard's jobs in the city.

ctx.x: Oh, Lily Warner was going back. He kept on getting in a long time, didn't he?
Oh, he had to be the Pope of the town, man. He's playing all of Richard's jobs in the city.
I guess that's how he kept the same man. Huh?
